say:1:1322025001:0.text: W-who are you? Don't come here... *Cough*... Otherwise, Stitchy will attack you.

choice_prompt:2:1322025002.text: Yes! The festival commemorating the war heroes, the special sapphirine blossom, the relics of the past… We learned of many things related to the war.
choice_prompt:2:1322025002.source_cn: 小男孩的话音未落，刚刚还安静乖巧地站在一边的傀儡玩偶将小男孩挡在身后，对你露出了凶狠的攻击姿态。
